title: Islamic Beliefs: Foundations
welcome_lead: Today you'll meet the foundational Islamic beliefs: Tawhid, the Six Articles of Faith and the nature of Allah.
meta_desc: GCSE RS Islamic Beliefs foundations — Tawhid, Six Articles of Faith, Allah's nature.
final_note: You now know the core beliefs of Sunni Islam and the Shi'a foundations of faith.

concepts.def: The oneness and unity of Allah
Associating partners with Allah — the gravest sin
The afterlife and Day of Judgement
Angels — beings created from light who serve Allah
Predestination — Allah's knowledge of all things

walkthroughs.body_html:
Tawhid — the oneness of Allah — is the central belief of Islam.

Surah 112 (al-Ikhlas): 'He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'

The opposite is shirk — associating anything with Allah — the gravest sin in Islam.

Sunni Muslims hold Six Articles of Faith:

1. Tawhid (oneness of Allah)
2. Malaikah (angels)
3. Kutub (holy books)
4. Risalah (prophets)
5. Akhirah (afterlife / Day of Judgement)
6. Al-Qadr (predestination)

Shi'a Muslims hold Five Roots of Religion (Usul ad-Din):

1. Tawhid
2. Adalat (justice of Allah)
3. Nubuwwah (prophethood)
4. Imamah (leadership through Imams)
5. Mi'ad (Day of Resurrection)

Both branches agree on Tawhid as the heart of Islam.

options: Five
Six
Seven
Ten
Tawhid is the name of an Islamic prayer position.
The absolute oneness and indivisibility of Allah — the most fundamental Islamic belief. Its opposite, shirk (associating partners with God), is the gravest sin.
Tawhid is the Islamic word for the Trinity.
Christians believe everyone is reincarnated until they accept Jesus.

mcqs.q: What do Christians mean by resurrection, and how does it differ from reincarnation?
options: Christians believe everyone is reincarnated until they accept Jesus.
Tawhid is the name of an Islamic prayer position.

Resurrection is the once-for-all bodily raising to eternal life at the end of time (modelled on Christ's resurrection); reincarnation is the soul's repeated rebirth into new bodies. They are distinct doctrines from different religious traditions.
Resurrection and reincarnation are basically the same idea of life after death.

mcqs.q: What does Buddhism teach about suffering?
options: Buddhism teaches that life is nothing but pain and misery.
All existence involves dukkha (suffering/unsatisfactoriness), caused by tanha (craving and attachment); ending craving leads to liberation from suffering.
Tawhid is the name of an Islamic prayer position.
Buddhism teaches that suffering is caused by demons.
